means: American and European comic-book art - heavier rendered musculature, cross-hatched or airbrushed modelling, and face and eye proportions unlike anime.
does: In the positive it does not give you a stylish crossover, it gives you a confused hybrid - anime eyes on comic-book anatomy - or a full drift off the model competence. It is in the standing negative here for that reason. There is a second, sharper reason to keep it out, documented under character consistency in craft/ANIME_MODELS.md: a Western-comic character sheet fed to an anime checkpoint fights itself, and the sheets on this project had to be regenerated with the anime model before IPAdapter would behave.
reach_for_it: never in the positive on this checkpoint. If you genuinely want that look, change checkpoints - do not try to tag your way there.
